title: Bible Answer is on the App Store
summary: Bible Answer 1.0 is out for iPhone and iPad, joining the Mac version released on October 28. It is free, with no account, ads or subscriptions, in six languages.

title: bibleanswer.app is open in six languages
summary: The Bible Answer website is live in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Russian, French and Filipino, with a press kit, the privacy policy and support.
